articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Inside the chain settling $150 billion of stablecoins a week
articles.snippet: Tron launched as a content-distribution project and has become the settlement layer for a large share of the world's USDT, processing roughly $150 billion to $190 billion of stablecoin transfers a week. Josh Olszewicz of Canary Capital breaks down how the network's economics work and what stablecoin regulation could do to the thesis.

articles.title: BlackRock says AI agents could drive stablecoin and crypto adoption
articles.snippet: The asset manager sees payments as the nearer-term opportunity, while markets for computing capacity remain at an early stage

articles.title: Coinbase users can now borrow USDC against bitcoin at a fixed rate
articles.snippet: Coinbase now allows users to borrow the USDC stablecoin against their bitcoin at a fixed interest rate and repayment date.

articles.title: European central banks push to expand stablecoin yield ban to crypto lending and staking
articles.snippet: Central bankers argue that indirect yield structures blur the line between electronic payment tokens and commercial bank deposits, distorting financial system competition.

articles.title: US stablecoin adoption could surge with bank-like protections: Visa survey
articles.snippet: The survey released by Visa posited that bank-like protections for stablecoins could increase adoption in the US as companies are preparing for the enactment of the GENIUS Act.
